column1: # USMS IAM audit - accepted findings (Lab 09 Exercise 2). Read by scripts/utilities/usms-iam-audit.sh.
# role<TAB>finding-text-prefix<TAB>reason. An entry with no reason is ignored, so nothing is
# accepted silently. Review this file whenever a listed role changes.

column3: EC2 sends no aws:SourceArn when an instance profile is assumed, so the confused-deputy condition cannot be written. Compensating controls: IMDSv2 required with hop limit 1 on usms-web-01 (Lab 09 Step 11); the role is reachable only through usms-ec2-app-profile; USMSDeployBase explicitly denies iam:PassRole to ec2.amazonaws.com.

Same EC2 reason as usms-ec2-app-role (EKS nodes are EC2 instances using an instance profile). Out of Lab 09's audited scope (Labs 07-08); on this build the nodes are a local k3s container. Revisit with IRSA in a later EKS review.

Out of Lab 09's audited scope (Labs 07-08). EKS supports aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn on the cluster role; add them in the EKS review, not here, because a wrong condition stops the control plane managing its network interfaces.
A Lab 01 exercise role with no function deployed. When one is, give it the same aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn conditions as usms-lambda-exec-role (policies/trust-lambda-scoped.json).
A service-linked role: AWS owns and maintains its trust policy and it cannot be edited (iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy is refused for service-linked roles). Accepted by design.

Lab 10 Step 6. The Lambda@Edge execution-role trust in AWS documentation carries no Condition, and CloudFront runs replicas of the function in other Regions, so the lambda statement's ArnLike us-east-1 SourceArn condition cannot simply be copied (Floci 2.2.0 never assumes the role for an edge replica, so a condition could not be tested here). Compensating controls: the lambda.amazonaws.com statement keeps its Lab 09 conditions; the role carries only USMSLambdaBasic (logs writes and s3:GetObject on usms-student-data/*); only version-qualified ARNs can be associated. Lab 10 Exercise 2 put the current edge versions on a dedicated usms-edge-exec-role, but this statement stays: versions 1 of both edge functions are immutable and still run as this role, so removing edgelambda here would break a rollback to them. Remove it once no associated or rollback-candidate version names this role.

Lab 10 Exercise 2. Same reason as the usms-lambda-exec-role entry (no documented Condition for edge replicas, untestable on Floci 2.2.0). The blast radius is smaller: the role carries only USMSEdgeBasic, CloudWatch Logs writes on /aws/lambda/usms-edge-* and /aws/lambda/us-east-1.usms-edge-* log groups, and nothing on S3.
